exams.name: Elevator Mechanic Examination
exams.notes: Either a department-administered written examination or a nationally recognized elevator industry examination
exams.quote: He or she satisfactorily completes a written examination administered by the department covering the provisions of this subchapter, and rules promulgated under this subchapter, that are relevant to the license applied for or satisfactorily completes an elevator mechanic's examination approved by the department and administered by a nationally recognized training program established by the elevator industry.

exams.name: Manufactured Home Installer Examination
exams.notes: Tests skills necessary to properly install manufactured homes and knowledge of applicable laws
exams.quote: The individual completes, to the satisfaction of the department, an examination approved by the department that tests the skills necessary to properly install manufactured homes and knowledge of the laws applicable to manufactured home installation.

exams.name: Contractor Continuing Education Examination
exams.notes: Required only for persons who do not hold a certificate of financial responsibility on April 11, 2006
exams.quote: For a person who does not hold a certificate of financial responsibility on April 11, 2006, successful completion of an examination developed by the department on the continuing education courses required under this subsection.

interval_years.quote: Except as provided under sub. (2) (c) and (d), the term of each license is 2 years.

required.quote: Completion every 2 years of at least 12 hours of continuing education relevant to the professional area of expertise of the person seeking to obtain a building permit, approved by the department.

hours_per_period.quote: Completion every 2 years of at least 12 hours of continuing education relevant to the professional area of expertise of the person seeking to obtain a building permit, approved by the department.

period_years.quote: Completion every 2 years of at least 12 hours of continuing education relevant to the professional area of expertise of the person seeking to obtain a building permit, approved by the department.

value: attendance at professional meetings or educational seminars for building contractors and inspectors
topical_requirements.quote: The hours of continuing education required under this subdivision shall include a total of at least 4 hours of continuing education on construction laws and codes and contracts, liability, and risk management every 2 years.

available.quote: The department may enter into a reciprocal agreement with another state under which credentials issued to electricians, electrical apprentices, electrical contractors, and electrical inspectors by either state are recognized as comparable credentials by the other state.

requirements.value: The education, experience, and examination requirements in the other state must be at least equivalent to Wisconsin's requirements. The individual must submit an application, pay applicable fees, and hold a valid comparable credential from the other state.
requirements.quote: Under the agreement, the department may recognize credentials from the other state only if the education, experience, and examination requirements in the other state are at least equivalent to the education, experience, and examination requirements for being issued credentials under this subchapter.
